targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMP(metric_ts) AS time, CAST(open AS FLOAT64) AS open, CAST(high AS FLOAT64) AS high, CAST(low AS FLOAT64) AS low, CAST(close AS FLOAT64) AS close FROM `${gold_dataset}.fct_market_metrics` WHERE ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) AND ('${instrument_id:csv}' = '$__all' OR instrument_id IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${instrument_id:csv}', ','))) AND metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) ORDER BY 1

SELECT TIMESTAMP(metric_ts) AS time, CONCAT(exchange, ':', instrument_id) AS metric, CAST(volume AS FLOAT64) AS value FROM `${gold_dataset}.fct_market_metrics` WHERE ('${exchange_multi:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange_multi:csv}', ','))) AND ('${instrument_id_multi:csv}' = '$__all' OR instrument_id IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${instrument_id_multi:csv}', ','))) AND metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) ORDER BY 1

SELECT TIMESTAMP(metric_ts) AS time, CONCAT(exchange, ':', instrument_id) AS metric, CAST(close AS FLOAT64) AS value FROM `${gold_dataset}.fct_market_metrics` WHERE ('${exchange_multi:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange_multi:csv}', ','))) AND ('${instrument_id:csv}' = '$__all' OR instrument_id IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${instrument_id:csv}', ','))) AND close IS NOT NULL AND metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) ORDER BY 1
